definition: This dimension controls the diversity and uniqueness of the content generated by procedural algorithms, affecting how varied the levels, items, and monsters are in each playthrough. It varies in the extent of randomness versus thematic consistency, impacting player experience and replayability.
exclusion_criteria: Static item lists that do not change between sessions
inclusion_criteria: Different types of items and weapons generated in each run
Varied monster types and behaviors across playthroughs
title: Content Variety in Procedural Generation
